The '''hydrotoboggan''' was a long [[Sled/Legends|sled]]-like vehicle used by the [[Lake Umberbool Shore Patrol|Shore Patrol]] to cross the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] surrounding [[Lake Umberbool]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It could carry up to four [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and merely required a push to get started. The hydrotoboggan was faster than a [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]].
